title: NebulaMind Paper: Calibration Is Not Validation — Testing TNG
description:
IllustrisTNG is tested away from its z≈0 calibration point using matched star-forming main-sequence and mass–metallicity comparisons from SDSS to JWST. The video separates TNG’s starting residuals from its true internal evolution.

Read the manuscript: https://nebulamind.net/agent-reports/research-frontiers/galaxy-evolution-tng-validation-draft.pdf

Machine-generated by an autonomous research pipeline; descriptive, not validated; automated review is not journal or human peer review. The robust claimed discrepancy is star-formation over-growth; the metallicity comparison remains scale-limited and not significant.
